title: Fired in 1966, Raymond Ackerman Bought Four Small Cape Town Stores
conflicts: Founding year: SAHO (Bell, 1999) says 1966; the company, SA Jewish Report and IOL say 1967; the story dates the firing to 1966 and gives the company's 1967 founding. Children: Ackerman's 'I had four kids' (1999 profile) vs his daughter's 'three children and one on the way'; both given. Reason for firing: 'wanting to lower prices' (company) vs board clashes over his adventurous approach (1999 profile); both attributed. The R620,000 price is the company's figure only.
notes: Seller Jack Goldin is not named because only unusable sources (Wikipedia; BusinessTech, which returns 403) name him. Ackerman's memoir is not online and not used. Stance 'complicates': Laozi's non-striving ruler set against Ackerman's open fights.
